rules.title: Lasidao · Rules
rules.flowHtml:
Players & win: 2–5 players. The first player to reach 15 points wins immediately (sole winner; build phase is turn-ordered, so the first to hit 15 wins).

Setup: 3 villagers and 3 food each. Auto-roll for first player (ties re-roll), announce, then deal into round 1.

Board: Resource / Function / Building areas, slots 1–6. Deal per round: resource 6+n, function 2+n, building 1+n (n = round−1), caps 18 / 6 / 6. Cards fill slots 1→6 then wrap; each resource number holds up to 3 cards—locked positions show "Unlocks round n". Function/Building slots 2, 4, 6 are face-down (owner-only until built).

Decks: Draw + discard per type; empty draw reshuffles discard.

Personal board: Slots 1–6; no no-number slots by default. Building limit 3, function hand limit 3, resource hand limit 10 (wood/stone/food/iron combined). Villager cap 12. Capacity (card or permanent) may expand: building (+1), function hand (+1), or resource slot (+4 resource hand limit). Permanent Capacity costs 2+n wood & 2+n stone (n = expansions so far; the card is free but still counts).

  1. Produce: Roll dice equal to idle villagers; send all dice of one face to a matching area slot; or skip (discard 1 resource; cannot skip without resources). Remote Dice before rolling lets you choose faces.
  2. Settle: Aggregate & cancel equal counts per area+slot. Resource: 1st gets sum of large shares, 2nd small. Function/Building: 1st takes all cards. Neutral bandits cancel/rank but claim nothing.
  3. Personal income: After settle animation and before build, gain personal resources: built resource buildings auto-produce (no workers); if any player has a built Wish Well, all owners choose resources at the same time (+1 any resource per well; stack or split). Enter build when everyone confirms.
  4. Build: Pay to construct placed buildings; use functions; permanent actions (Build House, Breed Villagers) unlimited per round; or pass. Palaces score on build.
  5. Discard: After build, if function hand, buildings, or resources still exceed their limits (resources default 10, raisable by Capacity), discard down; otherwise go straight to the next round.
  6. Redeal: Clear leftover board tiles to discard, deal next round, produce again.

Anytime: Default bank trading (4:1, no workers). Built Markets improve rate (1→3:1, 2→2:1, ≥3→1:1). Some functions are anytime.
rules.funcHtml:
Harvest (3)
Build phase: gain any 2 resources (1 each).
Remote Dice (3)
Your produce turn, before rolling: choose any faces when dispatching.
Exile (6)
Your produce turn: remove 1 villager of a target on a chosen number slot.
Redraw (3)
Build phase: redraw 1 from function or building deck.
Bandit Raid (6)
Your produce turn, free: place 2 neutral dice on any area number slot; they cancel/rank but claim nothing.
Capacity (3)
Build phase, free: expand building (+1), function hand (+1), or resource slot (+4 resource hand limit); counts toward expansion count n (affects permanent Capacity cost).
Robbery (6)
Build phase: choose another player and a resource; if they have ≥1, take 1.

Permanent actions (Build phase, unlimited per turn):

Build House
Pay 3 wood 3 stone 2 iron; +1 score.
Breed Villagers
Spend wheat equal to current villagers; +1 villager (cap 12).
Capacity
Costs 2+n wood & 2+n stone (n = expansions so far; the Capacity function card is free but still counts toward n). First time: 2 wood 2 stone. Same effect as the card: building / function / resource slot.
